cmqwkgd55042fnwqo3b19q15s.entry: Applicants must be in the final year of high school or have graduated, and hold foreign-applicant status under YÖK rules (diplomas earned by distance learning are not accepted). Applicants must also show they have the financial means to study in Türkiye. Exam scores are optional. If you submit one, the minimum is: TR-YÖS at least 100 points (as written in the directive), SAT I above 1000 with at least 500 in mathematics, ACT 21, GCE with A grades in at least 2 subjects (one related to the programme), IB diploma 28, or Abitur 4 or better. Language certificates are not needed to apply: English-taught programmes use a certificate or the university's placement/proficiency exam to decide on the prep year; Turkish-taught programmes need Turkish at B2.
cmqwkgd55042fnwqo3b19q15s.language: A Turkish certificate is not required to apply. For Turkish-taught programmes, a B2 Turkish certificate from a university TÖMER, Yunus Emre Enstitüsü or YTB, or passing the university's Turkish placement test, exempts you from Turkish study; otherwise one year of Turkish study at the university's Turkish Teaching Centre (extendable by one more year).
